description: This file contains implementations related to the 'rlw_iterator' and functions for iterating over compressed bitmap data structures, specifically within the EWAH bitmap compression scheme. It includes functions for initializing, discarding words, and discharging parts of the bitmap.

methods.name: int next_word(struct rlw_iterator * it)
methods.description: Reads the next 64-bit word from the bitmap and updates the iterator's rlw state accordingly.

methods.name: void rlwit_init(struct rlw_iterator * it,struct ewah_bitmap * from_ewah)
methods.description: Initializes an rlw_iterator with a given ewah_bitmap and loads its first word.

methods.name: void rlwit_discard_first_words(struct rlw_iterator * it,size_t x)
methods.description: Advances the iterator by discarding a specified number of words, adjusting run lengths and literal words accordingly.

methods.name: size_t rlwit_discharge(struct rlw_iterator * it,struct ewah_bitmap * out,size_t max,int negate)
methods.description: Outputs (discharges) up to 'max' words from the iterator into an output bitmap, with optional negation.

ctags.name: rlwit_discharge
ctags.signature: (struct rlw_iterator * it,struct ewah_bitmap * out,size_t max,int negate)
